LanguageData.PhobosRadioHf_DevOnly: The forecast for the sky from here, this hour. A band open on most days reaches that far; along the ground it reaches a tile or two besides.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioHf_Sun: Sunspots now: {SUNSPOTS}. The sun's cycle runs over {YEARS} game years.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioHf_NoTables: The HF tables could not be read.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioHf_BandNoise: {BAND}: the sky's noise here {NOISE} dBm in {KHZ} kHz.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioHf_Reach: {KM} km: open on {PERCENT}% of days (highest frequency {MUF} MHz).
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingConsoleNeedsReach: The comms console needs radio reach
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingConsoleNeedsReachDesc: Off by default. On, the comms console lists only the factions your stations can reach by radio, through relays and, with HF, by the sky: a far faction can be called only when a band is open to it. Passing ships are not affected. Off, the console calls every faction as usual.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingHfGreyLine: Show the grey line on the world map
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingHfGreyLineDesc: Off by default. On, the world map draws the edge between day and night round the globe while your colony is selected. HF often opens along it at dawn and dusk. A small drawing cost while shown.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingHfSkipRings: Show HF skip zones on the world map
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingHfSkipRingsDesc: Off by default. On, the world map draws a ring round your colony for each HF band, where the sky first brings it back down this hour: places inside it are skipped over, unless the ground wave reaches them. A small drawing cost while shown.
